_comment: Published GitHub metadata for this repo, recorded here so it can be checked against the tree.
GitHub's description and topics are set in the web UI / API, not in the repo, so nothing in the
product could ever contradict them: this file is the only place they are written down.
tools/check_repo_metadata.py re-reads this file and reports every claim about THIS tree that is
no longer true (a lab named in the description that isn't shipped, a topic for something the
README says is out of scope, a license that isn't the one in LICENSE).
Update this file in the same commit that changes a claim in it. It is not read by install.sh,
